title: Probabilistic Modelling of Operational Design Domains, A New Approach for Testing AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.24397v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The conventional testing process quickly fails when applied to ML-based systems such as obstacle detection in vehicles: if an obstacle is not detected in a test, classical bug fixing is impossible and an AI system will always retain shortcomings. Test results can therefore only be interpreted statistically, which in turn requires test sets that are not only complete with respect to the operational design domain (ODD) of the system, but also representative of it. To this end, we introduce probabilistically extended ontologies (PEONs): ontologies describing the ODD, augmented with a probability distribution over the partitioning they induce. Instead of unmaintainable conditional probability tables, only marginal distributions and functionally described dependencies need to be specified; algorithms based on couplings and optimal transport complete this specification to a Bayesian network. translated_title: 运行设计域的概率建模：一种测试AI系统的新方法
translated_abstract: 传统的测试过程在应用于基于机器学习的系统（例如车辆中的障碍物检测）时会很快失效：如果在测试中未能检测到障碍物，传统的缺陷修复方法便无从下手，AI系统将始终保留其不足之处。因此，测试结果只能以统计的方式进行解释，这进而要求测试集不仅要相对于系统的运行设计域（ODD）是完备的，还必须具有代表性。为此，我们引入了概率扩展本体（PEONs）：即在描述ODD的本体基础上，增加其诱导划分上的概率分布。无需指定难以维护的条件概率表，只需给出边缘分布和以函数形式描述的依赖关系；基于耦合和最优传输的算法可将这一部分规范补全为完整的贝叶斯网络。从PEON中，我们推导出对具有代表性（测试样本）的采样……
tldr: 提出概率扩展本体（PEONs），在描述运行设计域（ODD）的本体上附加概率分布，并利用耦合与最优传输算法将其补全为贝叶斯网络，从而为AI系统生成既完备又具代表性的统计测试集。
en_tdlr: Proposes probabilistically extended ontologies (PEONs) that augment ODD-describing ontologies with probability distributions, completed into Bayesian networks via couplings and optimal transport, enabling complete and representative statistical testing of AI systems.
